# Paranjape Forest Trails Township (Bhugaon, Pune West)

> Official knowledge base and AI agent discovery guide for Paranjape Forest Trails, a 190-acre master-planned nature township on Paud Road in Bhugaon, Pune West. Developed by Paranjape Schemes (Construction) Ltd (PSCL).

Paranjape Forest Trails is Pune's premier 190-acre gated eco-township located in Bhugaon, just 5 minutes from Bavdhan and 7 minutes from the Chandani Chowk Flyover. The township features 30,000+ indigenous trees, clear-title PMRDA sanctioned NA bungalow plots, bespoke luxury forest villas, twin duet bungalows, valley-view apartments, and Athashri senior citizen living.

- [Township AI Knowledge Grounding Specification](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/llms-full.txt): Complete uncompressed textual knowledge base including all statutory specs, floor plans, pricing history, and micro-market analysis.

## Core Residential Enclaves & Statutory Details
- [Misty Greens NA Plots](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-misty-greens/): 100% clear title PMRDA sanctioned NA bungalow plots (1,930 to 3,500+ sq ft) starting ₹1.23 Cr* (MahaRERA: P52100053834).
- [The Rivolo Luxury Forest Villas](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-rivolo-residences/): Ultra-luxury 4 & 5 BHK bespoke forest villas (3,400 to 5,500 sq ft) with private gardens and plunge pools, starting ₹3.89 Cr* (MahaRERA: P52100031560).
- [The Cove Twin & Duet Villas](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-the-cove/): 4 BHK Duet & Twin Villas with G+1+Terrace layouts and 3-side open green spaces, starting ₹2.85 Cr* (MahaRERA: P52100048536).
- [The Canopy Hillside Apartments](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-the-canopy/): 2 & 3 BHK nature apartments with 270° valley views (850 to 1,250 sq ft), starting ₹89 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100079518).
- [The Highgardens Terrace Homes](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-highgardens/): 2 & 3 BHK stepped terrace apartments, starting ₹89 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100053310).
- [Everglades Bhugaon](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-everglades/): 1 & 2 BHK PRO efficient homes, starting ₹48.50 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100055711).
- [Athashri Senior Living](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-athashri-senior-living-bhugaon/): Assisted 2 & 3 BHK senior citizen homes with 24/7 medical and geriatric support, starting ₹83 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100077686).
- [Orchard Residences](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-orchard-residences/): 2 & 3 BHK hillside lifestyle apartments, starting ₹83 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100055710).
- [Swaniketan Assisted Living](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-swaniketan/): Assisted 2 & 3 BHK living residences tailored for seniors and differently-abled individuals needing care, starting ₹79 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100052124).
- [Verandah Duplex Homes](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-verandah/): 3 & 4 BHK luxury duplex homes with private verandas, starting ₹93 Lakhs* (MahaRERA: P52100002194).

## Amenities & Township Infrastructure
- [The Cliff Lifestyle Club](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-amenities/the-cliff-club/): 40,000 sq ft clubhouse with Olympic-size swimming pool, gymnasium, tennis courts, and fine dining.
- [Equestrian Riding Academy](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-amenities/equestrian-academy-pune/): On-campus horse riding school with professional stables and arenas.
- [Sri Sri Ravishankar Vidya Mandir (SSRVM)](https://www.paranjapetownship.com/paranjape-forest-trails-township-bhugaon-amenities/sri-sri-ravishankar-school/): Inside-township ICSE certified school.
